text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
CapitalOf(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
Populous(x) ::: x is the most populous city.
Hosted(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
HasHosted(x, y) ::: x has hosted y.
RankedAmong(x, y) ::: x is ranked among y.
Universities(x) ::: x are universities.
Premises:
LocatedIn(beijing, northernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
CapitalOf(beijing, peoplesRepublicOfChina) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
Populous(beijing) ::: Beijing is the world's most populous national capital city.
Hosted(beijing, olympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics.
Hosted(beijing, paralympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Paralympics.
HasHosted(beijing, summerOlympics) ∧ HasHosted(beijing, winterOlympics) ::: Beijing has hosted both the Summer and Winter Olympics.
HasHosted(beijing, summerParalympics) ∧ HasHosted(beijing, winterParalympics) ::: Beijing has hosted both the Summer and Winter Paralympics.
∀x (Universities(x) → RankedAmong(x, topUniversities)) ::: Many of Beijing's universities are ranked among the best in the Asia-Pacific and the world.
Conclusion:
LocatedIn(beijing, southernChina)
